title: Restore RangeSlider initial position afeter clear query
body:
![](https://d17oy1vhnax1f7.cloudfront.net/items/090o0K1B1Q1o0L1y3n32/Screen%20Recording%202016-12-08%20at%2008.43%20pm.gif?v=f2e1c1ca)

When you type a query, the range slider adapt the `min` and `max` values based on the criteria, but, when you clear the query, it should be restoer the initial position (30 and 1500 repectively).

Could be easily checking the value of the `query` in the component, but I don't know how to.

Another thing: as you can see, in the first state, the value 30 and 1500 are the "base values" and they are not applied as a facet, but when you type a criteria, the new base values are applied as facet. Could be possible control that? this behavior is a little crazy, specially when you have more than one rangeSlider, check on https://windtoday.co/ what happens when you type something 😂

My [code](https://github.com/windtoday/windtoday-app/blob/master/src/app/Range/index.js) is based in the [rangeSlider code](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/widgets/RangeSlider.html).

Expected behavior: click [here](http://localhost:3001/?query=neylpride). It's have the query inside the URL, and the range sliders value are ok and not applied as facets.

comments.body:
woh, your `componentWillReceiveProps` solves the problem.

Thanks!
